thread:
ana: Noticed p99 for /v1/complete jumped at 18:05 while p50 stayed flat. Dashboard shows origin switched to backup pool. Any thoughts?
mike: Yep. We got a quota fallback at 18:04:42. Sample_count in that minute dropped to ~210. High-percentile estimates with tiny samples are noisy.
sara: If the rollup merges t-digests without preserving origin counts then a small backup cohort with heavy tail will push merged p99 up. We should surface sample provenance and confidence.
telemetry-bot: Quota fallback event: route=/v1/complete, from=primary to=backup, policy=quota_safety, time=2024-04-16T18:04:42Z
ana: Proposed quick UX: show sample_count next to each percentile, and a "confidence" icon that becomes red if samples < 300. Also add a provenance toggle to split by origin.
mike: Backend change needed: persist per-origin summary bundles and compute per-origin percentiles during query. Then UI can show merged value plus per-origin lines.
sara: Agree. For now, show dashed/low-opacity p99 when sample_count < 300 and tooltip: "High-percentile unreliable with low samples."
ana: I'll open a small console PR for the badge + tooltip. Mike, can you file the rollup schema issue?
mike: Will do, filing ENG-4701.
sara: Add an e2e that fakes a 20% shift to backup and asserts the confidence flag appears.
ana: Thanks — will follow up in ENG-4701.
